emotional_tone: Energetic, youthful, celebratory, tactile (like an actual physical treasure map)

typography.primary_font: System bold (rounded if possible) - prioritizing immediate readability and playfulness

layout.spacing_system: Generous padding: p-4, p-6, p-8 to prevent mis-clicks by kids. Use wide touch targets.
layout.container: flex-1 w-full bg-background items-center justify-center relative
layout.safe_area: MANDATORY: Use SafeAreaView from react-native-safe-area-context for all main screens to avoid notches.

components.buttons: Rounded-full, heavy padding (py-4 px-8), bold text, subtle shadow (shadow-md). Background: accent or secondary color. Press feedback: use active opacity.
components.modals: Centered absolute overlay with semi-transparent dark background (bg-black/60). Inner card: rounded-3xl bg-white p-8 items-center justify-center shadow-2xl. Width: 80-90% of screen.
components.hotspots: Absolute positioned TouchableOpacity over the map image. Minimum size 48x48 (touch target size) represented as a large bright star icon (@expo/vector-icons).
components.video_player: Fullscreen absolute video player using expo-av. Should cover the entire screen.

instructions_to_main_agent.framework: Expo React Native with Expo Router. This is NOT a web app anymore, it's a mobile app.
instructions_to_main_agent.styling: NativeWind (Tailwind for React Native). Use standard Tailwind classes.
instructions_to_main_agent.storage: Use AsyncStorage (@react-native-async-storage/async-storage) for saving progress (closest equivalent to localStorage).
instructions_to_main_agent.icons: Use @expo/vector-icons (e.g., FontAwesome, Ionicons) for the stars/hotspots on the map.
instructions_to_main_agent.video: Use expo-av for Video playback. The user mentioned missing videos, so handle video playback gracefully: use remote URLs if provided, or show a static image background (from 'media' above) with a 'Skip Video' button if local MP4s are missing. Video should be absolute fill.
instructions_to_main_agent.edit_mode: Since it's Expo Router, useLocalSearchParams() to check for ?edit=1. When active, tapping the map should calculate (touch_x/width)*100 and (touch_y/height)*100, log it, and temporarily show a hotspot.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing: CRITICAL: Add testID prop (React Native equivalent of data-testid) to all interactive elements for robust automated testing.
instructions_to_main_agent.readme: Ensure the README clearly explains how to replace the media assets (videos in assets/videos, images in assets/maps) and how to update src/huntConfig.ts.
